other.query: WITH base_data AS ( SELECT h.chw_code, h.chw_name, h.zone_code, s.nation_046_rank, s.nation_046_diagecode, s.nation_046_total, s.nation_048_rank, s.nation_048_diagecode, s.nation_048_total, s.nation_056_rank, s.nation_056_diagecode, s.nation_056_total, s.nation_057_rank, s.nation_057_diagecode, s.nation_057_total FROM chospital h JOIN {{S_TABLE}} s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = '2569' ), province_ranks AS ( SELECT DISTINCT chw_code, chw_name, rk, zone_code FROM ( select changwatcode chw_code, changwatname chw_name, zonecode zone_code from cchangwat where changwatcode <> '99' ) p CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 5) AS rk ), r046 AS ( SELECT chw_code, nation_046_rank as rk, string_agg(distinct nation_046_diagecode, ',') as diag, SUM(nation_046_total) as total FROM base_data GROUP BY chw_code, nation_046_rank ), r048 AS ( SELECT chw_code, nation_048_rank as rk, string_agg(distinct nation_048_diagecode, ',') as diag, SUM(nation_048_total) as total FROM base_data GROUP BY chw_code, nation_048_rank ), r056 AS ( SELECT chw_code, nation_056_rank as rk, string_agg(distinct nation_056_diagecode, ',') as diag, SUM(nation_056_total) as total FROM base_data GROUP BY chw_code, nation_056_rank ), r057 AS ( SELECT chw_code, nation_057_rank as rk, string_agg(distinct nation_057_diagecode, ',') as diag, SUM(nation_057_total) as total FROM base_data GROUP BY chw_code, nation_057_rank ) SELECT pr.chw_code as a_code, pr.chw_name as a_name, pr.rk as main_rank, r46.rk as nation_046_rank, r46.diag as nation_046_diagecode, r46.total as nation_046_total, r48.rk as nation_048_rank, r48.diag as nation_048_diagecode, r48.total as nation_048_total, r56.rk as nation_056_rank, r56.diag as nation_056_diagecode, r56.total as nation_056_total, r57.rk as nation_057_rank, r57.diag as nation_057_diagecode, r57.total as nation_057_total FROM province_ranks pr LEFT JOIN r046 r46 ON pr.chw_code = r46.chw_code AND pr.rk = r46.rk LEFT JOIN r048 r48 ON pr.chw_code = r48.chw_code AND pr.rk = r48.rk LEFT JOIN r056 r56 ON pr.chw_code = r56.chw_code AND pr.rk = r56.rk LEFT JOIN r057 r57 ON pr.chw_code = r57.chw_code AND pr.rk = r57.rk WHERE ( pr.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( pr.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) ORDER BY pr.chw_code, pr.rk;
